_about: Hand-curated requirement specs for the Senior AI Engineer JD. Every requirement cites verbatim JD text in jd_anchors; src/requirement_map.py fails if an anchor is not found in the parsed job_description.docx. positive_queries = concepts whose presence SUPPORTS fit on the requirement; negative_queries = concepts whose presence CONTRADICTS it (for risk requirements they describe the risk pattern). Negative concepts are retrieval probes for contradicting evidence, not automatic penalties. importance is the JD's stated emphasis (0-1), not a learned weight. Add a requirement by appending an object here; no code changes needed.

categories.technical_preference: JD 'Things we'd like you to have but won't reject you for'.
categories.experience: Kind and setting of past work (applied ML in production, product companies, shipped systems).
categories.career_risk: Patterns the JD says it rejects or will probably reject.
categories.domain_fit: Whether the candidate's actual domain matches NLP/IR/ranking rather than adjacent fields or keyword lists.
categories.behavioral: Redrob platform availability and responsiveness signals.

jd_strength_levels.preferred: Nice to have; JD says it will not reject without it.
jd_strength_levels.ideal_profile: From 'How to read between the lines' ideal-candidate description.
jd_strength_levels.probable_disqualifier: JD: 'we will probably not move forward'.
jd_strength_levels.explicit_exclusion: Listed under 'Things we explicitly do NOT want'.

jd_anchors: Production experience with embeddings-based retrieval systems (sentence-transformers, OpenAI embeddings, BGE, E5, or similar) deployed to real users.
